hero.title: The enterprise calendar
hero.content: Stop doing double-data entry across multiple apps. Weblings Calendar automatically pulls in your active Streamline sprint tickets and scheduled Team Chat calls into a single, unified visual timeline. Filter out the noise and see exactly what your company is delivering this month.

zeroDoubleEntry.title: A unified timeline that builds itself.
zeroDoubleEntry.description: Because all Weblings apps share the same database, your calendar is always up to date. You never have to manually copy a deadline from a project board or a meeting from a chat channel ever again.

cards.title: Auto-Synced Streamline Tickets
cards.description: When your team plans a sprint or assigns an epic in the Streamline app, those tasks automatically render as multi-day visual blocks on the calendar. You get an immediate, bird's-eye view of exactly which tasks extend until when, making it effortless to map out your month's development plan.

cards.title: Auto-Synced Team Chat Calls
cards.description: When you schedule a video huddle or client meeting inside the Team Chat app, it instantly populates on the unified calendar for all invited participants. The event includes a direct button to join the call, ensuring nobody misses a meeting because it wasn't on their schedule.

organization.title:
Filter out the noise.
See only what matters.
organization.description: A calendar is useless if it's too cluttered to read. We built a robust filtering engine so you can instantly switch context without feeling overwhelmed.

points.title: Global Toggle Switches
points.description: Want to just see developer tasks? Flip off the "Meetings" and "Events" toggles. In one click, your crowded monthly view transforms into a clean, distraction-free sprint timeline.

points.title: Custom Color Tags
points.description: Visually separate your schedule by assigning custom, color-coded tags. Create tailored labels for different projects, urgent client deliverables, or internal HR events, making them easily identifiable at a glance.

points.title: Custom Ad-hoc Events
points.description: Need to block out time for deep work or set a personal reminder? You can quickly create custom events and reminders directly within the calendar, independent of your tickets and chats.

realityCheck.title: We are not an isolated island.
realityCheck.description: We know you don't work in a vacuum. Your clients use Google Workspace. Your vendors use Outlook. We built Weblings Calendar to sync flawlessly with the outside world.

cards.title: 2-Way External Sync
cards.description: Full, native integration with external providers. If a client sends a Google Meet invite to your Weblings Inbox, it instantly renders on this calendar. If you generate a meeting here, it sends a perfectly formatted `.ics` payload that works beautifully in Outlook.

cards.title: Global Timezone Intelligence
cards.description: Scheduling across distributed engineering teams is a nightmare. Our engine automatically normalizes all data. If a PM in London schedules a sprint kickoff for 10:00 AM GMT, your developers in India will see it perfectly rendered at 3:30 PM IST on their localized dashboards.

cards.title: HR & Sprint Collision
cards.description: Because E-Office (HRMS) shares the same database, approved leaves are fed directly into the calendar. If you try to schedule a critical Streamline Epic for a week when your lead backend engineer is on PTO, the calendar issues an immediate collision warning.

mobile.title: Your Schedule, In Your Pocket.
mobile.description: Available on both iOS and Android. Whether you are traveling between branches or stepping away from your desk, your unified timeline is always perfectly in sync. Join video calls or review upcoming sprint deadlines directly from your phone.

cards.title: The Whole Office in Your Pocket
cards.description: Never miss a meeting or a deadline. Team members can view their upcoming week, check ticket extensions, and receive push notifications for upcoming team huddles—all dynamically synced from the rest of the Worksuite.

cards.title: Real-Time Oversight on the Go
cards.description: Stay tuned to your company’s macro schedule. Review major project delivery dates, monitor branch-specific holidays, and oversee global operations at a glance from your executive dashboard.

comparison.title: How much you can save
comparison.titleDescription: Reduce software costs by replacing multiple business tools with one unified workspace. Pay only for what your team needs and scale as your business grows.
comparison.badgeText: Save up to 50% with 2 additional features
